_comment: Named workouts for `pm5_workouts.py NAME` and `pm5_logger.py --workout NAME`. Keys: distance_m / time_s / calories with an optional split_m / split_s / split_cal; `interval` (one work/rest pair repeated until you stop); `intervals` (a list, optional `repeat`); `rest_s` per interval, omit it for rest that ends when you start rowing; `pace_s` is a target pace in seconds per 500 m; `just_row` with an optional split_m.
